description: MIRA Study — an activity (experiment/analysis) that produces evidence. Maps mira.yaml class Study (mixins NodeSchema, Activity). DRAFT.

main.description: A study/activity. 'follows' points at the protocols it enacts. 'grounds' is normally derived from science.mira.evidence.isGroundedIn; it may be asserted here when a study enumerates its own outputs.

description.description: MIRA dgb:description — what the study did.

attributedTo.description: MIRA creator, only when it differs from the signing repo DID.

follows.description: MIRA follows — Protocols this study follows.

grounds.description: MIRA grounds — Evidence this study grounds (usually derived as the inverse of evidence.isGroundedIn).
